common_verified_facts: The official HM Land Registry GOV.UK publication page and practice-guide identity were live-read.
The publication supplies legal or procedural guidance for registration, searches, protected interests, leases, insolvency, disputes or developing estates.
common_semantic_limits: A registration procedure, register entry, search result, notice, restriction, lease, charge or estate approval is not an exact parcel polygon or terrain raster.
No parcel height-difference result may be created without exact HMLR geometry, pinned EA DTM1m bytes, CRS, ODN, units, metric consistency and execution receipts.
